abstract: We herein report a case of ovarian clear cell carcinoma with an immature teratoma component that exhibited aggressive behavior. A 47-year-old woman presented with abdominal distention, and computed tomography detected a cystic mass on the right ovary. The resected mass had mural nodules, most of which showed a pale-yellow appearance; some nodules had a heterogeneous cut surface with bright yellow and white areas. Histologically, the former nodules were composed of clear cell carcinoma, while the latter contained teratomatous tissues, such as immature skeletal muscle, adipose tissue, and enteric glands. The tumor was staged as pT1c. Despite adjuvant chemotherapy and additional lymph node dissection, she had local recurrence and multiple liver metastasis 6 months after the first surgery. The disease rapidly progressed, and she died 9 months after the first surgery. Clear cell carcinoma and immature teratoma both showed ARID1A deficiency and an identical PIK3CA mutation, which suggested their clonal relationship.
abstract_ja: 侵襲的な経過をたどった未熟奇形腫成分を伴う卵巣明細胞癌の症例を報告する。47歳の女性が腹部膨満を主訴に受診し、CTで右卵巣の嚢胞性腫瘤が検出された。切除された腫瘤には壁在結節があり、その大部分は淡黄色を呈していた。一部の結節は明るい黄色と白色の領域が混在する不均一な割面を示した。組織学的には、前者の結節は明細胞癌から構成され、後者は未熟骨格筋、脂肪組織、腸管腺などの奇形腫様組織を含んでいた。腫瘍はpT1cと病期分類された。追加のリンパ節郭清を含む補助化学療法にもかかわらず、初回手術から6か月後に局所再発と多発肝転移を来した。病勢は急速に進行し、初回手術から9か月後に死亡した。明細胞癌と未熟奇形腫はいずれもARID1A欠損および同一のPIK3CA変異を示し、両者のクローン性関係が示唆された。
